evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of an episode of fainting.

Findings: Normal sius rhythm at 69 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 162 ms, QRS 85 ms, QTc
400 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with no acute ST-T wave chanes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
50%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function.

CO2: 25 mmol/L
BUN: 13 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.3 mg/dL (H)
Glucose: 169 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.1 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
